title: Integration
summary: ∫f(x)dx = F(x) + C where F'(x) = f(x). Standard results: ∫xⁿdx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1) (n ≠ −1); ∫dx/x = log|x|; ∫eˣdx = eˣ; ∫aˣdx = aˣ/log a; ∫sin x dx = −cos x; ∫cos x dx = sin x; ∫sec²x dx = tan x; ∫cosec²x dx = −cot x; ∫sec x tan x dx = sec x; ∫cosec x cot x dx = −cosec x.
∫dx/(x² + a²) = (1/a)tan⁻¹(x/a); ∫dx/(x² − a²) = (1/2a)log|(x − a)/(x + a)|; ∫dx/√(a² − x²) = sin⁻¹(x/a).
If the integrand contains a function and its derivative, put t = that function. Examples: ∫cos√x/√x dx = 2 sin√x (t = √x); ∫(log x)²/x dx = (log x)³/3 (t = log x).
∫u v dx = u∫v dx − ∫[u'∫v dx]dx (choose u by ILATE). ∫x cos x dx = x sin x + cos x + C. ∫eˣ[f(x) + f'(x)]dx = eˣf(x) + C.
Split rational functions, complete the square for quadratics, and use identities first: cos²x/(1 + sin x) = 1 − sin x; e^(3 log x) = x³.
mcq: If ∫2ˣdx = f(x) + C, then f(x) is —

mcq.work:
cos²x/(1 + sin x) = (1 − sin x)(1 + sin x)/(1 + sin x) = 1 − sin x.
∫(1 − sin x)dx = x + cos x + c.
Put t = log x, dt = dx/x: ∫t²dt = t³/3 = (log x)³/3 + c.
f(x) = 1/x has f'(x) = −1/x², so ∫eˣ[f + f']dx = eˣf(x) = eˣ/x + c.

objective: Match: (a) ∫sin x dx; (b) ∫sec²x dx. [cos x + c, log(sin x) + c, tan x + c, −cos x + c]
True or False: (a) ∫x cos x dx = x cos x + sin x + c. (b) ∫eˣ(2 log x + 2/x)dx = eˣ log x² + c.

(a) False — by parts: x sin x − ∫sin x dx = x sin x + cos x + c.
(b) True — 2 log x = log x² and its derivative is 2/x, so the form eˣ[f + f'] applies.
objective4: Evaluate: (i) ∫cos√x/√x dx; (ii) ∫e^(3 log x)·x⁴ dx; (iii) ∫sec²x/√(1 − tan²x) dx; (iv) ∫cosec x(cosec x + cot x)dx.

(i) t = √x, dt = dx/(2√x): 2∫cos t dt = 2 sin√x + c.
(ii) e^(3 log x) = x³, so ∫x⁷dx = x⁸/8 + c.
(iii) t = tan x: ∫dt/√(1 − t²) = sin⁻¹(tan x) + c.
(iv) ∫(cosec²x + cosec x cot x)dx = −cot x − cosec x + c.
